summary.en: Carries the ribs; anchors trapezius, rhomboids and erectors.
summary.zh: 连接肋骨，是斜方肌、菱形肌和竖脊肌的附着处。

detail.en: Twelve thoracic vertebrae, each with a rib on either side. Their spinous processes, the bumps you can feel down the middle of the back, anchor trapezius, the rhomboids, latissimus dorsi and spinalis; their transverse processes anchor longissimus [M47]. In this model they are one mesh, so the spine does not bend segment by segment.
detail.zh: 十二节胸椎，每一节两侧各连一根肋骨。它们的棘突，就是背中线上摸得到的那排骨性突起，是斜方肌、菱形肌、背阔肌和棘肌的附着处；横突则供最长肌附着 [M47]。模型里它们是一整块网格，所以脊柱不能一节一节地弯。

summary.en: Five large vertebrae of the low back; anchor the erectors.
summary.zh: 下背的五节大椎骨，竖脊肌附着在这里。

detail.en: The five lumbar vertebrae sit between the thoracic spine and the sacrum. The thoracolumbar fascia links their spinous processes to latissimus dorsi, and the erector spinae attach along them [M47]. The markers here stand for attachments through tendon and fascia, not bare muscle on bone.
detail.zh: 五节腰椎位于胸椎和骶骨之间。胸腰筋膜把它们的棘突和背阔肌连在一起，竖脊肌也沿着它们附着 [M47]。这里的标记代表经由肌腱和筋膜的附着，不是肌肉直接贴在骨头上。

summary.en: Rib angles anchor the erectors and serratus posterior.
summary.zh: 肋角是竖脊肌和下后锯肌的附着处。

detail.en: The sternum, twelve pairs of ribs and their cartilages, drawn as one mesh. On the back, the angles of the ribs anchor iliocostalis and longissimus, the lowest four ribs take serratus posterior inferior, and the lowest three or four ribs give slips to latissimus dorsi [M47].
detail.zh: 胸骨、十二对肋骨和肋软骨，在模型里合成一个网格。背面的肋角供髂肋肌和最长肌附着，最下面四根肋骨连着下后锯肌，最下面三四根肋骨还给背阔肌发出肌齿 [M47]。

summary.en: The moving base of the arm; most back muscles pull on it.
summary.zh: 手臂的活动底座，大多数背肌都拉着它。

detail.en: A flat triangle of bone that glides over the back of the ribs. Its spine and acromion take trapezius, its inner border the rhomboids and levator scapulae, its back surface infraspinatus and teres minor, and its lower corner teres major [M47] [M48]. Because these muscles pull from different sides, they can lift, lower, draw back and rotate it.
detail.zh: 一块扁平的三角形骨，贴着肋骨背面滑动。肩胛冈和肩峰是斜方肌的止点，内侧缘连着菱形肌和肩胛提肌，背面是冈下肌和小圆肌的起点，下角是大圆肌的起点 [M47] [M48]。这些肌肉从不同方向拉它，所以它能上提、下降、后缩和旋转。

summary.en: Links the shoulder girdle to the breastbone.

detail.en: Upper trapezius inserts along the back of its outer third [M47]. In this model the joints at both ends of the collarbone are simplified pivots.
detail.zh: 斜方肌降部止于它外侧三分之一的后缘 [M47]。模型里锁骨两端的关节都简化成了转轴。

summary.en: Takes the tendons of latissimus, the teres and the cuff.
summary.zh: 背阔肌、大小圆肌和肩袖的肌腱都止在这里。

detail.en: Latissimus dorsi ends in the floor of the intertubercular groove, teres major on its inner lip, and infraspinatus and teres minor on the back of the greater tubercle [M47] [M48]. These are separate attachments only millimetres apart.
detail.zh: 背阔肌止于结节间沟的沟底，大圆肌止于沟的内侧唇，冈下肌和小圆肌止于大结节的后面 [M47] [M48]。这些止点彼此只隔几毫米，却各不相同。

summary.en: Anchors latissimus and the common erector tendon.
summary.zh: 背阔肌和竖脊肌共同腱的附着处。

detail.en: The hip bones, sacrum and coccyx, drawn as one mesh. The back of the iliac crest and the sacrum anchor the common tendon of the erector spinae; latissimus dorsi reaches the crest through the thoracolumbar fascia [M47].
detail.zh: 髋骨、骶骨和尾骨合成一个网格。髂嵴后部和骶骨是竖脊肌共同腱的附着处；背阔肌借胸腰筋膜连到髂嵴 [M47]。

summary.en: Places the back muscles on the whole body.
summary.zh: 在全身上标出背部肌肉的位置。

detail.en: A simplified skin surface from the same reference body. X-RAY fades it so that you can see the muscles underneath [M3].
detail.zh: 同一具参考人体的简化皮肤。透视模式会把它调淡，让你看到下面的肌肉 [M3]。
